exposure: External cephalic version (ECV) in the presence of a uterine scar
External cephalic version (ECV) in the absence of a uterine scar
External cephalic version (ECV) with an unscarred uterus
cohort: 316 pregnant women with breech presentation (158 with a prior cesarean delivery and 158 without)
finding: ECV was found to be safe and effective in women with a prior cesarean delivery, with a success rate comparable to those without a uterine scar.
mod_finding: ECV in women with a prior cesarean delivery was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery compared to women without a uterine scar.
